summary: The filing reports a routine one-month extension of the deadline to complete an initial business combination, a standard SPAC administrative procedure. On June 11, 2026, TLGY notified its trustee of the intent to extend the termination date from June 17 to July 16, 2026. The sponsor deposited $10,000 into the trust account on June 15 to effect the extension. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. There are no structural mechanics beyond the deposit. This is not a special situation — it merely maintains the status quo while the SPAC continues searching for a target.
